artifacts.summary: Six-phase, 10-hour plan for the /slice build: script (check/build/status), series file, command file, suite, registration, redeploy; stops short of the operator-only push and pull-request step.

memory_candidates.content: Registering a new slash command in this agent system is a three-surface edit, not a one-line manifest edit: check-extension-docs.sh's README-vs-manifest command sub-check fails any provides.commands entry whose command name is not mentioned in that extension's own README.md, so manifest.json plus commands/<name>.md plus a README.md Commands-table row are all mechanically required before gate 3 passes. The deployed CLAUDE.md command table (merge-sources/claudemd.md) is NOT mechanically required -- a slash command is discovered from the deployed commands/ directory regardless -- so a command can ship invocable while its CLAUDE.md row is deferred to a doc-parity record. A new script plus its suite additionally needs a provides.scripts pair (Rule Q flags an undeclared source script) and a suite-classification.data row (lint-unit-integration-boundary.sh fails an unclassified discovered suite).
